title: Personalized Baseball Bedding Full Size Flag Custom Name D - Design 02
description:
Experience personalized comfort with the Jeminise Baseball Bedding Comforter Set. This set is perfect for baseball enthusiasts, offering a unique way to showcase your love for the sport with custom name options. Designed for softness and durability, it transforms any bedroom into a fan's dream.

Key Features

  • Meaningful Gift: Ideal for baseball players, fans, and lovers, celebrating determination and passion for the sport.
  • Available Sizes: Offered in US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), and US King (104" x 88") to fit various bed dimensions.
  • Superior Manufacturing: Features an environmental protection finishing process that helps fabric hold dye and prevents fading, ensuring longevity.
  • Material Details: Crafted from 100% Brushed Polyester Fabric for a soft, comfy, durable, and lightweight feel, with Whole-Piece Microfiber Filling to prevent clumping.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water; can be air dried without heat for quick drying and to maintain fluffiness.
  • Customization: Includes options for 2 text inputs for personalization.
  • Versatile Use: Suitable for all seasons, providing comfort year-round.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter Set
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Polyester, Cotton
Selected Design Baseball Thunder
Pattern Baseball
Included Components Duvet Cover
Customization 2 text inputs
Available Sizes US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), US King (104" x 88")
Special Feature Breathable
Seasons All
Care Instructions Machine Wash
Thread Count 400
